children: *China's DeepSeek to Tap Citic Securities for IPO, Sources Say
China's DeepSeek Plans to Hire Citic Securities for Shanghai IPO
China's DeepSeek is planning to hire state-owned investment bank Citic Securities to prepare for an initial public offering in Shanghai, people familiar with the matter said.

The artificial-intelligence startup is also talking with other investment banks, including China International Capital, about serving in an advisory capacity, the people said. DeepSeek aims to submit its IPO application to Chinese authorities by the end of this year, said the people, who declined to be identified.
DeepSeek, Citic Securities and CICC didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
Reuters had earlier reported on the AI lab's plan to tap Citic Securities.

Seen as a symbol of Beijing's push for AI dominance, DeepSeek's path toward an IPO is being closely watched. A successful listing would be a milestone moment for China's rapidly-advancing AI industry.
The Wall Street Journal had previously reported that the Hangzhou-based company is raising money in a private financing round that values it at around $74 billion.
DeepSeek's investors include a state-backed fund focusing on AI, tech giant Tencent and battery maker Contemporary Amperex Technology, the Journal has reported.

Chinese AI companies have been ramping up fundraising activities following the IPOs of two AI model developers, Z.AI and MiniMax, in Hong Kong in January. According to the Journal, fellow developer Moonshot AI has confidentially submitted an application for an initial public offering to Hong Kong's stock exchange.
